### Check if a job is covered

Jobs that have HBC cover are listed on the free public register HBC check. Anyone can use HBC check to confirm that a builder or tradesperson has valid cover for the residential work they're doing in NSW.

faqs.q: What is Home Building Compensation (HBC) cover?
faqs.a: HBC cover helps protect homeowners if their builder causes damage to the home.

faqs.q: When do I need HBC cover?
faqs.a: You must hold HBC cover of at least $340,000 before starting any work or taking any money (including a deposit) for a residential home or renovation project.

faqs.q: Do I need HBC cover if I use a subcontractor?
faqs.a: You do not need HBC cover if you subcontract the work from another licensed contractor.
